column2: a welcoming haven for both travelers and locals. Familiar
column3: authentic materials like red brick and dark wood casework and paneling frame a space topped by a perforated tin ceiling. The navy and brass color palette echoes the restaurant’s logo and reinforces the visual brand identity
column4: beginning with the storefront and carrying through to the blue damask wall coverings and tile floor.  Antique brass and wood bar shelving and classic pendant lighting provides warmth and glow. Brass accents appear throughout the space on custom mirrors and frames of artwork
column6: as well as storefront signage and door hardware. The newly landscaped exterior patio has a modern style that incorporates traditional materials: a natural stone fireplace and teak furniture with dark metal frames which complement the structural steel and cedar of the new outdoor bar.

column2: curated artwork commissioned from local artists draws inspiration from the rich history of Sewickley
column3: a small town on the Ohio River whose forgotten days of riverboats and roaring 20’s are revived with authenticity and regional flavor in illustrations and paintings.
